items.title: The announcement wire went quiet — and that's the story.
items.body: After a month of institutional news — the Foundation's operational launch, Ripple and MoonPay buying in, the hyperscalers shipping edge support — no major protocol or member announcement landed this week. In a young standard's life, the weeks nobody announces anything are the weeks the software gets written.

items.title: Catch-up worth reading: the hyperscaler split.
items.body: InfoQ's July analysis is the clearest side-by-side in print on the two edge implementations: AWS CloudFront's x402 support is generally available at no charge beyond standard WAF pricing, while Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway remains waitlist-only with no pricing or timeline. Same protocol, opposite go-to-market. The demand argument rides in one number from the same piece: Cloudflare measures 52% of crawler requests as AI-training traffic now, up from 22% in spring 2025 — alongside Coinbase-reported first-year totals of 169M+ payments across roughly 590K buyers and 100K sellers.
